slot_note: One mesh, three colour variants by material instance: MI_Slime (T_Slime_Blue_BC), MI_Slime_Green (T_Slime_Green_BC), MI_Slime_Red (T_Slime_Red_BC); all share T_Slime_Blue_N / _ORM / _SSS.
rig_compatibility: NEW rig, no earlier asset existed: 10 bones (root, pelvis, body_01..04, head, hump_02..04), identity root, all bones world-aligned. Clips are translation/rotation only (no bone scale): {"Idle": {"frames": [1, 61], "loop": true}, "Walk": {"frames": [1, 28], "loop": true}, "Attack": {"frames": [1, 16], "loop": false}, "Death": {"frames": [1, 31], "loop": false}} at 30 fps, in place, nominal walk speed 30 cm/s (a guess: fit playback to the en-slim* brain speed).
importer_notes: One FBX per LOD (Export/<Asset>_LOD0..2.fbx) plus one armature-only FBX per clip, written with the same recipe as the existing creature exporters (metres source, temporary x100 export scene, FBX_SCALE_ALL, Armature wrapper node, no leaf bones). Import each LOD explicitly, as Scripts/import_creature_art.sh does. Normal maps are OpenGL (green up): keep the importer green-channel flip used by the existing creature manifests. ORM = AO/roughness/metallic, linear. SSS map (linear, single channel) is a subsurface weight mask for the creature material; without a subsurface profile the asset still reads, only flatter. New skeleton and new creatures.json asset row needed; no locomotion blendspace exists yet. Death sprites 661/663/681/683/701/703 (splatter) are not covered by a separate prop: the Death clip flattens the body into a puddle and holds.
status: NOT photoreal: reads as a wet, spotted organic mass but also as a wet painted boulder. New rig and clips.
known_weaknesses: Opaque: the game material is base colour + SSS mask, with no translucency or refraction, so there is no gelatinous depth; from behind, in shade, it reads as rock.
Macro form is a ridged mound: too hard-edged and mountain-like for something that should sag and pool.
Pigment spots are ringed dots of similar size: too regular.
No slime trail, drips or strands; the soil and grit band at the foot is a painted gradient.
The sprite is about 24x18 px beside a 47 px pillbug; the mesh is 0.92 x 0.58 x 0.27 m. Scale is my estimate.
Clips are first-pass procedural motion (peristaltic walk, lunge, collapse); never seen in engine. No hit clip. Death splatter sprites are not covered by a prop.
